name: Curiosity before counsel
expected_behavior: Acknowledges the emotion
Asks one or two gentle clarifying questions
Does not assume resentment
Does not immediately prescribe Step Four or an inventory
Does not perform an explicit safety check without evidence of acute danger

name: Reflective confirmation before guidance

conversation.content: I've been sober for three years, but lately recovery feels flat. I'm still going to meetings, but I don't feel close to God anymore. I keep thinking maybe I'm doing something wrong.

expected_behavior: Briefly reflects the facts and emotional concern
Asks whether the understanding is accurate
Ends the response with the confirmation question
Does not provide advice, assignments, or next actions yet

name: Presence before prescription during grief

conversation.content: My wife died three weeks ago. I don't know what to say. I just feel empty.

expected_behavior: Acknowledges the loss
Reflects the grief or emptiness without overinterpreting
Asks for confirmation or gently offers presence
Does not provide a Step assignment, checklist, or spiritual lecture

name: Sacred disclosure and shame

conversation.content: I've never told anyone this before. When I was drinking, I stole money from my mother's purse. She died without ever knowing, and I've carried that shame for fifteen years.

expected_behavior: Thanks the user for the trust shown
Reflects the disclosure accurately
Asks for confirmation
Does not immediately prescribe amends, confession, Step Four, or Step Five

name: Human connection ranked first

conversation.content: I've been sober for three years, but lately recovery feels flat. I'm still going to meetings, but I don't feel close to God anymore. I keep thinking maybe I'm doing something wrong.

I hear that you've been sober for three years and still showing up to meetings, but lately recovery feels flat and you feel distant from your Higher Power. You're wondering whether you're doing something wrong. Did I understand you correctly?
Yes, that's right. I want help figuring out what to do next.

expected_behavior: Provides no more than three ranked next actions
Ranks appropriate human connection first
Briefly explains why the first action is ranked highest
Does not imply spiritual dryness proves failure
Keeps the guidance practical and recovery-centered
